question: Under a newly synchronized authoritative US100 2024-plus real-tick history cache, does the exact previously frozen imbalance between squared positive and negative completed-M15 returns produce a sufficiently frequent and double-spread-positive one-market-hour dominant-variance or counter-variance response to retain one later standalone additive entry-prototype question?

selection_rationale.retained_seed_audit: Every prior non-null research seed was consumed or closed; the Unit 019 retained item is the frozen forward engineering baseline rather than an open research seed.
selection_rationale.official_source_audit: Treasury auction demand, SEC market-structure metrics, FINRA short volume, CME volume/open-interest and NYSE LULD roles either repeat closed external-state, participation, positioning, liquidity, cost or admission decisions, or lack complete market/constituent coverage.
selection_rationale.legacy_audit: The apparent unrevisited-range-tail role is already economically closed at the legacy anchor with every declared full-cost path negative in both selection halves; it is not an unconsumed role.
selection_rationale.program_4_reopen_rejected: Unit 060 requires 2022H2-2023 three-symbol real-tick integrity. Later valid matrices begin in 2024 and do not prove that missing interval; deleting it would be a forbidden period rescue.
selection_rationale.why_program_1_despite_recent_concentrati: Unlike Units 093 and 094, this is not a symbol extraction, neighboring threshold, grid, clock, horizon, direction or subgroup variant. It is the exact economically unread Unit 032 contract, made newly executable by a later authoritative history-cache synchronization, and directly addresses the high-turnover entry objective.
selection_rationale.perspective_distance: Single-symbol signed realized-variation distribution over sixteen completed M15 returns, rather than Unit 093 cross-symbol convergence or Unit 094 static price-lattice crossing.

frozen_prior_invalid_boundary.invalidity: The first P1 2024H1 path stopped normally with 24,099,625 valid ticks, 1,529 resolved observations, equal visible specifications and zero detailed history warning, but the HTML label was 99 percent rather than the frozen 100 percent requirement.

us100_2024_first_selection_cache_change.classification: normal annual HCS synchronization over unchanged authoritative monthly real ticks

materially_new_authoritative_input.timing: The synchronized HCS and valid path were created and frozen on 2026-08-28, after Unit 032 closed on 2026-08-26.
materially_new_authoritative_input.readiness_only: No Unit 094 economics and no closed Unit 032 opportunity economics select or tune this contract. Unit 094 is used only to prove that the previously missing authoritative 2024 US100 history state can now exist.

scientific_basis.measure: Realized semivariance decomposes high-frequency variation into squared positive-return and squared negative-return contributions.
scientific_basis.scope_limit: The literature supports asymmetric information in signed variation, especially future volatility. It does not authorize the one-hour return direction here; dominant and counter directions are therefore both fixed symmetrically and must earn their own executable-cost result.

fixed_observer.semantic_contract: Byte-for-semantic reproduction of Unit 032. Only the new family identity, output paths and audit labels may differ.
fixed_observer.evaluation_clock: At the first valid executable tick of each newly opened US100 M15 bar, inspect only sixteen returns ending at the immediately completed bar.
fixed_observer.valid_tick: Bid and ask are positive and ask is not below bid; executable mid is their arithmetic mean.
fixed_observer.continuous_history: The current bar and all seventeen completed close observations needed for sixteen returns have exactly 900 seconds between every adjacent bar time. Session reopen and every discontinuity are excluded.
fixed_observer.return_definition: For completed bars k=1 through 16, natural log of close[k] divided by close[k+1].
fixed_observer.positive_energy: Sum of squared strictly positive returns.
fixed_observer.negative_energy: Sum of squared strictly negative returns.
fixed_observer.zero_returns: Excluded from both sign counts and energies.
fixed_observer.trigger: While no observation is unresolved, trigger at the first valid tick of the new M15 bar when both sign-count minima hold and absolute variance imbalance is at least 0.35.
fixed_observer.dominant_variance_direction: BUY for positive imbalance and SELL for negative imbalance.
fixed_observer.horizon: Resolve at the first valid executable tick after four subsequent US100 M15 market-bar advances, equal to one market hour without counting closed-market time.
fixed_observer.overlap: At most one unresolved observation. No candidate is evaluated while one remains active; a new evaluation may occur at the same boundary immediately after resolution.
fixed_observer.entry_prices: Current ask for BUY and current bid for SELL.
fixed_observer.exit_prices: Current bid for BUY and current ask for SELL.
fixed_observer.observed_cost_profit: OrderCalcProfit at 0.01 volume using actual trigger and resolution bid/ask.
fixed_observer.double_spread_profit: Apply one additional trigger spread and one additional resolution spread against each direction, then call OrderCalcProfit.
fixed_observer.eligible_variance_day: A distinct server date containing at least one idle continuous evaluation with valid closes, positive total energy and both sign-count minima.

tester_contract.model_name: Every tick based on real ticks

environment_contract.origin: One lean physical copy from the canonical neutral Lab Tester Portable, not from Unit 094 or any other family runtime.
environment_contract.required_raw_tick_scope: US100 monthly real-tick TKC files 2024-01 through 2026-07 inclusive; 2022-2023 and incomplete 2026-08 are outside every path and invariant.
governing_inputs: exact source, SET, INI and EX5 manifests
full symbols database and visible US100 start/end contract specification
for each path, exact exercised annual HCS plus intersecting monthly TKCs
environment_contract.first_use_synchronization: A fresh portable may normally rewrite an annual HCS or symbols database on first selection. Such a path is invalid and economically unread; preserve it, refreeze the new exact environment and restart the complete four-path matrix from P1.
environment_contract.matrix_continuity: Any governing fingerprint drift, missing report, non-normal stop, HTML below 100 percent, detailed absent/discarded/mismatch/generation telemetry, observer fault or row-count mismatch invalidates the incomplete matrix before economics. Preserve the attempt, correct only the demonstrated implementation/environment defect, refreeze and restart all four paths.
environment_contract.correction_governance: There is no arbitrary numeric cap on pure implementation or environment corrections. No threshold, window, sign count, period, cost, metric, gate or terminal decision may change.
environment_contract.complete_matrix_gate: Do not read opportunity economic columns or calculate a direction metric until all four paths form one complete valid matrix under their frozen per-path inputs and stable shared source/configuration/binary/specification identity.
environment_contract.post_complete_matrix: No selective Tester rerun. One successful fixed aggregation only.

path_metrics: eligible variance days/evaluations, resolved opportunities and opportunities per eligible variance day
observed-cost net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
double-spread net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
fixed_aggregation.pooled_metrics: Concatenate the four ordered path books without compounding volume and calculate the same metrics plus path contribution shares.
fixed_aggregation.zero_profit: Neither win nor loss; exclude from profit-factor numerator and denominator while retaining opportunity count.

fixed_selection_gate.integrity: All four paths pass the complete matrix contract.
frequency: At least 0.40 resolved opportunities per eligible variance day pooled.
At least 0.25 resolved opportunities per eligible variance day in at least three of four paths.
economic: One direction book has positive pooled double-spread net USD.
Its pooled double-spread profit factor is at least 1.10.
Its double-spread net is positive in at least three of four paths.
Its pooled double-spread net divided by pooled maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.50.
No one path contributes more than 70 percent of the direction's total positive-path double-spread profit.
fixed_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing direction by higher pooled double-spread net, then higher profit factor, then more positive paths, then lexicographic direction name.
fixed_selection_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one unopened later standalone additive US100 entry-prototype question for the selected direction. Unit 096 places no trade and selects no stop, hold extension, size above 0.01, portfolio priority, implementation, promotion or Live candidate. Any later prototype requires a new whole-map comparison and separate declaration.
fixed_selection_gate.failure_action: Close the entire realized-variance-asymmetry axis with no candidate or seed.
fixed_selection_gate.invalid_action: If authoritative input cannot form a complete valid matrix after demonstrated implementation/environment defects are exhausted, close INVALID without economic judgment and without an adjacent repair.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before deriving source/configuration, creating a runtime, compiling or opening any new Tester path.
Derive a new self-contained sibling root once; do not modify or execute source from the closed Unit 032 family and do not touch the forward baseline.
Compile the exact new family identity and output paths at 0 errors and 0 warnings before Tester execution.
Record every demonstrated implementation or environment correction before retry; corrections have no arbitrary count cap but cannot change the economic contract.
Do not inspect any partial opportunity economic field before a complete valid four-path matrix exists.
Perform one fixed economic aggregation and one terminal verdict only.
Do not query broker/account/position/order/deal state, read the Live research ledger, alter Program 6 or touch Live.
